children: Pioneer Power Solutions Inc. (PPSI) filed a Form 8K - Director, Officer or Compensation Filing - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on November 20, 2026.

On November 18, 2026, Pioneer Power Solutions, Inc. (the "Company") and Nathan J. Mazurek, the Company's Chief Executive Officer, entered into a sixth amendment (the "Mazurek Amendment") to that certain Employment Agreement, dated as of March 30, 2012, as amended on each of November 11, 2014, June 30, 2016, March 30, 2020, April 25, 2022, and December 26, 2023 (as amended, the "Mazurek Agreement"), in order to extend the termination date of the Mazurek Agreement from December 31, 2026, to December 31, 2027.

The foregoing summary of the Mazurek Amendment contained in this Item 5.02 does not purport to be complete and is subject to, and qualified in its entirety by, the full text of the Mazurek Amendment, a copy of which is attached hereto as Exhibit 10.1 and incorporated herein by reference.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1449792/000149315226053559/form8-k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1449792/000149315226053559/0001493152-26-053559-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
